Exercise 10 · Example. In the name of God, the Clement, the Merciful. Citizens, towns and cities, today we find ourselves on our national holiday, not only to celebrate the past, but to build the future. Our fathers taught us that the country is not built by words, but by work; It is not defended by slogans, but by sacrifices. In these years we have achieved what no one expected: roads that connect villages to cities, schools that open the doors to the children of the poor, hospitals that approach the sick. But the road is still long, and the challenges are still great. Do our young people not have the right to find work in their homeland? Doesn't every mother have the right to remain calm about her children's future? Yes, and that is why I am announcing today a national youth employment programme, which will create fifty thousand jobs in three years; And we shall work to make all the rulers reach its fruit. Citizens, the ship of the homeland sails only through the arms of his children. Let us work together, hand in hand, for a homeland that welcomes everyone, protects everyone and needs everyone. Long live your homeland. Peace be with you, and the mercy of God and His blessings. □ Synthesis: On the occasion of the national feast, the President has claimed the results of recent years in infrastructure, school and health care and announced a program for youth employment from fifty thousand places in three years, without indicating its cost. □ Exercise 11.
